documents.heading: Saltglass Harbor
documents.rule: During a red tide the north gate must stay closed.
documents.detail: The charter is kept above the eastern toll desk. Weather readings go into a weekly register that remains visible to travelers. Bronze inlays on the floor mark the old town boundaries. Council clerks carry spare pencils and leave them beside the lamp hooks.

documents.heading: Ashward Council
documents.rule: Only Regent Mara can overturn a harbor-court verdict.
documents.detail: The council chamber has small blue windows facing the channel. Voters are called by district during morning sessions. Witnesses wait in the alcove and may read printed schedules. High tide reaches the steps at the back of the building after evening bells.

documents.heading: South Ferry
documents.rule: The South Ferry departs after the second bell.
documents.detail: Passengers use a sloping jetty under willow trees. A covered stall lends umbrellas for a coin. Chalk signs list weather conditions. Some visitors walk along the wall and watch the pilots prepare their ropes.

documents.heading: Silver Watch
documents.rule: The Silver Watch carries brass lanterns.
documents.detail: The watch guard carries damp cloaks and usually stops at the corner shed. The courtyard includes benches and a shallow basin. The banner hangs under a timber arch. Locals sweep the alley before the shift changes.

documents.heading: Chapter Three
documents.rule: In Chapter Three, Tess carries the Ironsilk Blade.
documents.detail: Tess crossed the reeds as light moved on the wall. Loose rope coils lay on a long slate landing. She recognized the boatman by the mismatched cuffs on his coat. A cold wind disturbed the pond beyond the gate.

documents.heading: Chapter Seven
documents.rule: Lian hides the map in the Lantern Archive.
documents.detail: At the turning, Lian paused to close a clasp before climbing the hill. Lamps hung along the passage on iron chains. The earliest visitors had placed sprigs of rosemary in a stone cup. Several workers were already folding cloth covers.

documents.heading: Salt Oath
documents.rule: The Moor Guild and Glass Fleet are allies under the Salt Oath.
documents.detail: Two identical copies of the treaty exist. The stamps represent the first day when both delegations could cross the channel. The tables are made of smooth grey wood. A low cabinet holds strips of paper for the winter invitations.

documents.heading: Chapter Nine
documents.rule: Ambassador Sera waits at Cliff Station.
documents.detail: Air from the open window lifted the paper tickets. Travelers counted red roof tiles on the station. The path curved below a quarry where lamps hung against the stone. The waiting room stayed bright until shortly before sunrise.
